facts.fact: Newsday reports the Information Regulator told the Mail & Guardian by 30 September 2026 it had received no Section 22 notification and would engage the Gauteng Department of e-Government.
The Information Regulator is acting on the e-Panic Button breach under POPIA.
Newsday states Section 22 of POPIA requires notifying the Information Regulator of suspected unauthorised access to personal information.
The Information Regulator said it would engage the Gauteng Department of e-Government on the breach and urge POPIA compliance, with no decision stated.

ZAF.note: The e-Panic Button is an emergency app of a provincial department; no national gateway or ten-service count stated.
Only the public panic app and a breach are described; no station record system stated.
